queries.We will design a simple yet efficient ad: instance-conditioned adaptation function incorporating problem scale and pairwise node distances as a learnable bias in attention-free transformer neural solvers for large-scale vehicle routing and TSP generalization
queries.We will replace traditional Multi-Head A: Attention-free transformer AFT-full replacing multi-head attention in neural vehicle routing solvers, integrating an instance-conditioned adaptation function into encoder attention to capture pairwise node relationships and reduce computational complexity for large-scale TSP and CVRP.
queries.We will develop ICAM using an encoder-de: encoder-decoder neural vehicle routing solver using a 12-layer attention-free transformer encoder, instance-conditioned adaptation function, adaptation attention-free module, and decoder compatibility calculation for large-scale constructive TSP and CVRP
queries.We will implement a progressive training: progressive multi-stage training for neural vehicle routing solvers using small-scale warm-up, varying-scale instance sampling, top-k elite trajectory selection, and joint POMO plus top-k loss to learn scale-independent features and improve large-scale generalization
queries.We will evaluate ICAM on three routing p: Neural combinatorial optimization reinforcement learning routing solvers evaluated on Traveling Salesman Problem, Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem, and Asymmetric Traveling Salesman Problem benchmark instances from 100 to 5000 nodes for cross-scale generalization
queries.We will compare against classical solver: Benchmarking instance-conditioned neural vehicle routing solvers against Concorde, LKH3, HGS, POMO, MatNet, ELG, Pointerformer, MCTS, TAM, and GLOP using optimality gap, solution quality, and inference time for large-scale TSP, CVRP, and ATSP.
queries.We will assess performance using objecti: Performance evaluation of neural constructive vehicle routing solvers for TSP, CVRP, and ATSP using objective values, optimality gaps versus LKH3, inference times, single trajectory, multiple trajectories, and instance augmentation for cross-scale generalization
queries.We will conduct systematic ablation stud: Systematic ablation studies for an instance-conditioned neural vehicle routing solver, evaluating adaptation function components, attention-free transformer versus multi-head attention, progressive training stages, encoder depth, and learnable scale-distance parameter alpha for large-scale TSP, CVRP, and ATSP generalization.
queries.We will evaluate generalization capabili: Cross-scale generalization evaluation of instance-conditioned neural vehicle routing solvers on rotated and exploded TSP and CVRP instances and TSPLIB and CVRPLIB benchmark datasets to test robustness beyond generated instance distributions.
